scope: Native end-to-end configuration A/B; not a pure engine-patch causal estimate
method: Per-sample interval unions, overlaps subtracted; no independent p95 sums. Backend commit-ack spans are asynchronous elapsed annotations, excluded from synchronous application work. Frame residual includes compositor, IPC/event-loop waiting and uninstrumented work, not certified idle time. API elapsed includes unobserved detached Canvas work; not pure Rust CPU. WebKit timer precision is approximately1ms in these samples.

comparability.shared: Same debug Tauri binary, WebKitGTK2.54.1, Xvfb, xdotool native ASCII, zoom50, warmup3, groupStart30/extend30/undo20/redo20; busy probe off
differences: Pinned shipped WASM build command/compiler/wasm-opt provenance not recorded in BUILD.json; candidate Rust1.93.1 release --no-opt
Candidate test adapter uses queued full-page jobs; pinned application uses existing summary/damage path. These are configuration timings, not isolated scheduler speedup.
